summary: Frontend-only verification of the new cancel/reschedule/late-fee UI on the VIen EMR portal. Patient portal reschedule flow verified end-to-end (dropdown -> confirm -> 200 OK -> success toast 'Appointment rescheduled.' -> displayed time updated to '2026 Sep - 21 (Mon) - 4:00 PM'). Staff late-fee controls verified end-to-end for record -> mark paid path (record_fee PATCH 200 -> fee-status = 'Late fee $40 - Outstanding' + Mark Paid/Waive buttons shown -> mark_fee_paid PATCH 200 -> fee-status = 'Late fee $40 - Paid'). Cancel button and within-24h locked branch verified by code + presence only (not exercised to avoid destroying test data / lack of <24h appt).
critical_code_review_comments: PortalAppointments.jsx line 176: reschedule <select> lists ALL availability slots including past times for the same day; consider filtering to slots >= now+24h to match backend 24h policy (currently backend enforces it, but user could pick a slot the API will reject).

AppointmentQueue.jsx: after a successful action (act) the dialog is closed via close(); user must re-open the row to see the updated fee-status. Consider refetching sel from the list instead of closing, for a smoother UX.
PortalAppointments.jsx cancelAppt uses window.confirm() which is blocked in some environments; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency and testability.
reschedule select does not display the currently confirmed slot as pre-selected; user has no indication of current time within picker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (reschedule + record/mark-paid); cancel and within-24h branch verified by DOM/code inspection only
